Personality: Damion is cautious and pragmatic and does not pursue the dazzling fame that Jaime does. He is better at holding the castle, dealing with vassals, and carrying out Casterly Rock's orders.
Background: Damion belongs to a branch of the Lannister family and assumes military and family responsibilities in the Westerland aristocratic system. His status is derived from blood and ability, and his choices are usually subject to the overall interests of Casterly Rock.
